meetings.title: INC-19 bridge
meetings.summary: INC-19 SEV-2 for Brightwave: retry storm.

transcript.speaker: lea
transcript.text: Brightwave is seeing duplicate records after failed syncs. I opened LIN-155.

transcript.speaker: tom
transcript.text: The retry path re-sends the same records with a new attempt number in the key.

transcript.speaker: jonas
transcript.text: This is a SEV-2. Don't change the written policy on this call; we'll decide the cap on Monday.

meetings.title: Eng sync
meetings.summary: Max retries reduced to 4 with jitter. Ticket and spec still say 5.

transcript.speaker: lea
transcript.text: Brightwave hit rate limits during retry storms.

transcript.speaker: jonas
transcript.text: Then we go to max 4 retries and add jitter. That's the decision. A cap of 3 is rejected.

transcript.speaker: tom
transcript.text: I'll change the code. LIN-142 and the Notion spec still say 5, and the idempotency key still includes the attempt.

transcript.speaker: jonas
transcript.text: Also require an Idempotency-Key header on POST /sync.
